newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on USDA stocks data.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on USDA stocks data.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher after USDA reduced its estimate for 1996-97 ending wheat stocks, traders said.
"This was the busiest its been in a long time," a MGE floor source said after the close.

All U.S. wheat markets opened higher after the USDA November crop report pegged wheat ending stocks at 435 million bushels. That marked a sharp decrease from USDA's October estimate of 470 million bushels.
U.S. wheat markets also received a late boost as CBOT soybeans rallied off their lows.
MGE spring wheat closed steady to six cents per bushel higher, with December up six cents at $4.07-1/2.
Traders said significant bear-spreading pressured nearby MGE December to close off its earlier high at $4.15.

Commission houses were noted among the leading players. Traders said Cargill bought 2.5 million bushels of December spring wheat. Benson-Quinn bought 1.6 million Dec and sold 800,000 Dec. Wilson Trading sold two million March.
MGE barley futures closed 13 to 14 cents per cwt higher, with Dec up 13 cents at $6.55.
Traders noted that the Dec/March spread had traded as wide as 20 cents a bushel Tuesday, after trading at 17 cents late Monday.
Atwood-Peavey bear-spread 3.5 million March/Dec bushels at 17 to 18 cents, traders said, while LFG bull-spread three million Dec/March at between 18 and 20 cents.
